2610.09193.title: Bookkeeping, Composition, or Unreachable Gold? Reading MemoryAgentBench's Conflict-Resolution Scores Against a Frozen Last-Write Resolver
2610.09193.paper_summary: MemoryAgentBench's Conflict Resolution split is read as measuring "selective forgetting". We execute the benchmark's own rule - the newest statement about a fact wins - as a zero-learning resolver frozen on one of the four fact lists. Under the official metric the rule answers 80.25% of the questions (74.5% on the three held-out lists). Of the rest, 67 items have a released gold that the last-write graph cannot reach but overwritten statements would ("The capital of India is New Delhi." superseded by "The capital of India is Grosseto."; gold New Delhi); such items are a third of the multi-hop questions at 262K. Two long-context models and our pre-registered approximate re-implementation of the benchmark's BM25 agent, one retained run per item and outcomes only, score 84.7%, 82.6% and 41.6% on the items the rule solves against 10.4%, 11.9% and 6.0% on those 67. The failures are a reachability split plus a small parser-scope residual; the per-item split, not the aggregate, is the unit at which a score here can be read.
2610.09193.paper_summary_zh: MemoryAgentBench的衝突解決分割被解讀為測量「選擇性遺忘」。我們執行基準測試自己的規則 - 關於事實的最新陳述獲勝 - 作為一個在四個事實列表之一上凍結的零學習解決者。在官方指標下，該規則回答了80.25%的問題（在三個保留列表上為74.5%）。其餘的67個項目有一個釋放的金標，最後寫入的圖無法達到，但被覆寫的陳述可以達到（「印度的首都為新德里。」被「印度的首都為格羅塞托。」所取代；金標為新德里）；這些項目是262K多跳問題的三分之一。兩個長上下文模型和我們預註冊的基準BM25代理的近似重新實現，每個項目保留一個運行和結果，對於該規則解決的項目得分為84.7%、82.6%和41.6%，而對於那67個項目的得分則為10.4%、11.9%和6.0%。失敗是可達性分割加上一個小的解析器範圍殘留；每個項目的分割，而非總體，是在此處可以讀取分數的單位。
2610.09193.author: Egor Pakhomov et.al.
